summary: Everus Construction Group filed an 8-K reporting that on September 1, 2026 it entered into a First Amendment to its October 31, 2024 credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment refinances existing first-lien term loans, increasing the aggregate principal amount by $200.0 million to $477.5 million, and refinances and increases revolving commitments by $125.0 million to $350.0 million, including a $50.0 million letter-of-credit sublimit. Pricing improves to Term SOFR plus 1.75%–2.50% and lower commitment fees. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
